title: Define and freeze Operational System Phase 3 architecture and Role Dispositions
objective: Define and freeze the exact Phase 3 role architecture, data/authority/threat maps, recovery/capacity/lifecycle policies, fault and Safe Degradation design, and five evidence-backed Role Dispositions without device action, qualification, release, Phase 4, or broader adoption.

scope.description: Exactly 18 private-repository documentation, task, validator, test, trace, report, handoff, and manifest paths; external review and Git delivery remain separate.

non_goals: Recollect, normalize, reinterpret, or replace Phase 2 observations
Access or operate the current Mac, Seagate, 2015 MacBook, Worker, Observer, credentials, permissions, private content, or PRIVATE VAULT
Assign QUALIFIED_FOR_BOUNDED_ROLE or QUALIFIED_OUT without the requirement-specific objective evidence
Implement software, configure a service, integrate hardware, begin Phase 4, or run a fault, restore, rebuild, update, retirement, or end-to-end exercise
Qualify or release the Operational System, accept residual risk, authorize Public Release, or perform broader adoption
Complete or predict external review, pushed ref, pull-request, merge, or final acceptance identity inside the immutable package
Amend, rebase, reset, force-push, delete, merge, or rewrite history
requirements: Use the merged C4 commit bb5a0c6cc807939621c9c6efa4dae8f1e7fc1cc7 and exact frozen source identities.
Apply DEAS Strict with Document, Evidence, Validator, Python, AI-Assisted, and Git overlays to exactly 18 paths.
Produce every planned Phase 3 evidence identity required by the traceability matrix while separating design evidence from implementation and qualification evidence.
Define roles, Storage Role candidates, classified flows, minimum signals, authority, threats, accepted RPO/RTO, capacity gaps, lifecycle controls, and all 37 fault mappings.
Give exactly five candidate devices/components exactly one evidence-backed Role Disposition each.
Use BLOCKED_PENDING_EVIDENCE wherever the frozen evidence supports neither qualification nor disqualification.
Preserve NOT_YET_QUALIFIED and NOT_YET_RELEASED throughout the package.
Keep all physical, remote, storage, credential, permission, destructive, Phase 4, release, and broader-adoption actions outside the package.
Provide a fail-closed public validator with positive, negative, boundary, source, lifecycle, and manifest tests.
Freeze the 17 non-manifest paths in one sorted SHA-256 manifest whose own digest is external.
acceptance_criteria: The tracked diff contains exactly the 18 affected_files and no unrelated path.
The seven Phase 3 evidence records each contain all 23 canonical DEAS evidence fields exactly once.
Every EV-P3 identity is produced and bidirectionally linked from the updated traceability matrix.
The exact candidate inventory is CP-CANDIDATE-01, SR-CANDIDATE-01, WK-CANDIDATE-01, WK-SW-CANDIDATE-01, and OBS-CANDIDATE-01.
All five frozen candidate dispositions are BLOCKED_PENDING_EVIDENCE, with candidate-specific evidence bases and reconsideration needs.
The public Phase 3 validator returns package-scoped PASS and names G7, G8, and G9 as pending.

All eleven public validator cases pass, including missing/extra file, invalid disposition, missing evidence field, manifest mismatch, source drift, false qualification, invalid digest, and out-of-root rejection.
Canonical DEGS validate and evaluate return PASS with no warning, and Python syntax/function bounds, JSON, links, manifests, diff hygiene, and secret scan pass.
The task remains READY_FOR_EXECUTION with embedded independent review and post-action validation PENDING; the handoff remains READY_FOR_GIT_DELIVERY.
No device action, Phase 4, qualification, System Release, Public Release, or broader adoption occurs.
assumptions: The merged C4 tree and every source identity in source-register.md remain unchanged during this generation.
The Phase 2 evidence limitations and unknowns are current as evidence gaps, while all measured operational values are historical rather than current facts.
No separately defined device-evidence task is selected by the instruction to define and freeze this package.
alternatives: Treat the Phase 2 package as a qualification result
Assign a bounded role from component presence or age
Invent missing capacity, lifecycle, support, or recovery values
Combine architecture definition with device evidence or Phase 4 implementation
Leave the candidate inventory or Phase 3 evidence identities implicit
selected_design: Freeze one contract-first architecture generation with seven evidence records, exact five-candidate BLOCKED_PENDING_EVIDENCE dispositions, explicit unknowns, fail-safe states, deterministic validation, and no downstream action.

rollback.procedure: Preserve the exact merged base, complete-history bundle, owned lock, candidate bytes, manifest, test output, and any later immutable commit. Do not amend, reset, rebase, force-push, delete, merge, or automatically erase failed work; use an identity-checked follow-up for restoration.

risk_analysis.summary: Tier 1 reversible private-repository architecture, documentation, validator, test, trace, and manifest work with exact paths, frozen sources, fail-closed validation, and no operational action.

target_identity: Merged base bb5a0c6cc807939621c9c6efa4dae8f1e7fc1cc7 plus exactly 18 Phase 3 paths and the externally bound phase-3-sha256.txt.
blast_radius: Exactly 18 private DobeWorks repository paths; no device, configuration, service, Phase 4, qualification, release, public, destructive, or broader-adoption action.
stop_conditions: A base, branch, source, lock, writer, path, manifest, private-remote, or candidate identity changes unexpectedly.
Any required check fails and cannot be corrected within the exact 18-path definition authority and two correction passes.
A candidate disposition would require an unsupported fact, exception, or value stronger than the frozen evidence supports.

Any device, storage, content, credential, authentication, permission, physical, destructive, service, configuration, Phase 4, qualification, System Release, Public Release, or broader-adoption action would occur.

telemetry.reason: This Tier 1 definition package creates no running component or telemetry source.

unresolved_items.message: Current Mac capacity, authoritative-copy, recovery, fault, and integration evidence remains incomplete.
Seagate topology freshness, health, redundancy, integrity, capacity, restore, lifecycle, and role fitness remain incomplete.
2015 MacBook exact device, support, recovery, exposure, and workload evidence is absent.
Worker software and Observer are not implemented or tested.
Required Phase 4 through Phase 7 integrated evidence does not exist; qualification and System Release remain blocked.
